verdict.reason: The best thing on the site for us: a status line that swaps state text with no layout shift, because a hidden sizer holds the longest string and every state centres inside it. Our generation trail currently reflows as stages change, and this is the measured fix. Reference only: the licence forbids redistributing their code, so the curve is re-implemented in our CSS, never copied.
